authoring_policy.basis: Each descriptor is a Russian-language projection of its exact approved natural layer value; source_profile_ref pins the original provenance and limitations.
limits: No local species, quantities, harvestability, rights, stability, depth, safety or precise geographic extent are added.
Machine baseline readiness never authorizes perception. Every non-none descriptor requires an exact independently admitted source_position_id and P22 conditions.

A source position must be resolved from the generated scene's approved arrival endpoint slot and committed endpoint-position binding; no actor-position or missing-binding fallback. Applicability to that source location requires scene owner admission.
P22 ordinal loudness 1 is an editorial low-intensity moving-water source, not a decibel measurement. Its audience requires the committed target ambient-noise baseline and approved propagation losses.
Wind, dynamic weather, season and light are not asserted by static descriptions. Temporal and causal sound owners retain their authority.
Partial visual visibility may suppress a descriptor when no partial_text exists; partial acoustic text does not identify the source.
No candidate authoring file is runtime authority before independent Astra approval, compiled catalog membership and release activation.
